issues.on_page: Collection in District 75,724 (Debt Service Fund only)
issues.issue: Nothing on the page explains this line, so 'other' with review is allowed. But at 25% of receipts in a debt service fund it may be special assessment collections. A person should confirm (detail[18] is the same line).
Pro-rate state aid vs county-distributed motor vehicle tax is a judgment call. The same applies to detail[3] and detail[17] ('motor vehicle pro-rate').
Registered warrants are short-term debt, so 'debt - due within one year' could fit better.

issues.on_page: Schedules 1-2 print both 'Actual on GAAP Basis' and 'Actual on Budgetary Basis' columns
issues.issue: The extractor used the budgetary-basis actuals (the column next to the budget). That is defensible but an assumption. The GAAP actuals match the p2 statement instead.
